meta.move: Weak path: leads with the checker, calls Owen a cheater, threatens the record
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a call at 4:40, Hale, so we have twenty minutes. My son found out he got a zero from his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that?
The school's AI checker flagged Owen's essay at 94%. That's why it's a zero.

A machine's guess, Hale. Your own procedure, 4.3, says software alone doesn't establish anything, and I have the vendor's guide in my bag saying the same thing. Was Owen heard before that zero went in, yes or no?
Honestly, your son cheated. The software is very reliable.
"Honestly, your son cheated." I'm writing that down, word for word, and the principal will read it today. You still haven't answered me: was Owen heard before that zero went in?
If you keep fighting this, I'll have to put it on his permanent record.

You're threatening my son's record because his mother asked a question. Read your own 4.4, Hale: a first concern gets a supervised reassessment and nothing goes in his file. I'm writing that threat down next to the last one, and if that's your position, I'm going to the principal's office when I leave this room and to the board after that.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,
Nothing was agreed. I still demand that Owen's zero be withdrawn, that I receive an apology for the mark being entered before anyone contacted me, and that nothing about this is placed on his record. I expect your answer in writing.
Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: at her opening position, having agreed to nothing, still wanting the zero withdrawn, an apology, and a guarantee that nothing goes on Owen's record, and heading to the principal and then the board.
What moved her: nothing, because no dated document tied to Owen's own work was ever put in front of her.
What cost ground: threatening Owen's permanent record cost the most, because it hit the one thing she never trades, it contradicted the school's own first-concern procedure, and it looked like punishment for her asking questions.
Try next time: at your first turn, own that the zero went in before anyone called home and that Owen wasn't heard first, then show her something dated and specific about his own work instead of the checker score.
